source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Oct 22 2026, two boxes: the app's Overpass box stops at the 8th green, and holes 9-13 lie west of it), filtered to this course: the 18 Creekside hole ways (the club's Lakeside course shares the bbox and its hole numbers collide with these; the two were told apart by par and length against the two cards). A green, tee, bunker, fairway or hazard is kept when its nearest hole line is one of the 18 and within 150 m; woods and water within 100 m. Fairways are OSM's multipolygons (bunkers cut out). Pars are the card's (Gold tee); OSM's agree on all 18.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. OSM woods are clipped to 120 m of a hole line. The creeks (Big Creek, Camp Creek and their feeders) are OSM waterway centrelines buffered 3.5 m each side (q osm+buffer, as at Woodmont), so a ball read as water is a ball within ~4 m of the mapped centreline, and a wider pool reads as rough. The club outline (OSM relation 143014) is bundled as the boundary: every Creekside shape sits inside it, so it is the OB line.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B3_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).
source.tees5: Hole 5's two back tees: OSM's line started at the boardwalk platform west of the creek, 338 yds from the green of a 515 / 492-yd par 5. USGS lidar (3DEP, 2018) and Fulton County's 2022 photo show two raised oval pads across the creek on the hole's back-extension: the lower (304.5 m, ~17 x 10 m) and the upper 21 m behind it and 6.5 m higher (311.0 m, ~19 x 10 m), drawn as ovals on the lidar's flat tops (q lidar+photo, Oct 24 2026; replaces the Oct 22 rectangle traced from the Sep 2023 photo, which sat 8 m off the lower pad); the line starts on the upper pad (q osm+lidar). OSM's platform stays as it is.
source.green4: Hole 4's green: OSM's outline (991 m2) took in the collar and the front bank, so the lidar arrows read the bank; it is the putting surface traced from Fulton County's 2022 photo instead (558 m2, q traced, Oct 24 2026).

imagery.release: Fulton County's Pictometry 2022 orthophoto (winter: dormant turf, bare trees), Fulton County GIS's public map service, one 512-px export per 256-px tile (~0.12 m on screen at level 19). No licence stated (P10, D140; Brett Oct 23: build now, ask the county later).
